text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I lost… Even though I said it'd never happen again!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey, do ya think I'm… that I'm underestimatin' this racin' stuff?
choice_data_list: We don't have time to mope!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. Quittin' now would spare me the blues, but I'd lose out on the thrill of gettin' wins, too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I know winnin' isn't easy. That's why I'm willin' to put in the work. I can't be gettin' all upset over a couple losses!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So thanks! I'm feelin' better already, and startin' tomorrow, I'll be right back to runnin' with my all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …You're right there. No amount of whinin's gonna make me faster.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All right! No more mopin'. Let's get back and get trainin'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna work real hard 'n win the next one for real!
